propositions: Two rollout config flags (baseline_dual_write and baseline_consumer_swap) are permanently enabled in production and must be retired and hardcoded as always-on.

The baseline dual-write advancement logic (binding_store.set_baseline calls) must be extracted and run unconditionally, while equivalence-check machinery (_mirrored_equal, divergence counting) must be deleted as dead.
Boolean threading through run_differs.py, outbound_differ.py, and outbound_fields.py that guards baseline consumption must be collapsed to unconditional baseline arbitration.

Cold-start repositories that never dual-wrote baselines will experience a one-pass local-wins window until baselines populate lazily; this window must be made observable via RECON: baseline_cold_start stderr logging and documented in setup guides.

The removal must be backward-compatible: configs naming the removed flags are silently ignored per removed-key backcompat; persisted baselines in bindings.json are additively ignored by older binaries per ADR-0026.
